sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Remarketing of Secondhand Hydraulic Earthmovers and Rollers

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law foundation with French Civil Law influences and customary land law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: China-Vanuatu Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2006, in force)
PACER-EPIC (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, regional free trade agreement)
Limited Double Taxation Agreement network; no comprehensive DTAs with major OECD jurisdictions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 12 of 2010 (as amended) and VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes; International Companies Act [CAP 222] (as amended) requiring registered agents to obtain and file beneficial ownership particulars; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Beneficial Ownership Register (restricted government access).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copies of Passport or Government-Issued National ID of each director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin of each individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a contracting party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Register of Directors and Shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (issued by the Vanuatu State Law Office)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (required for any corporate UBO in the ownership chain)
Bank Reference Letter or Corporate Legal Opinion for each corporate UBO above the 25% threshold
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Institutional bank or licensed counsel of the corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (where the source country is not party to the Hague Convention)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening under the AML/CTF Act No. 12 of 2010: customer and UBO identity verification; screening against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Australian DFAT Consolidated List, and any domestic Vanuatu sanctions notices; mandatory Politically Exposed Person (PEP) determination covering family members and close associates; enhanced due diligence (EDD) for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, and sanctioned-adjacent entities; ongoing transaction monitoring tailored to the medium-risk used heavy machinery trading profile; AML/CFT records retained for a minimum of five years; appointment of a Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) at the VFSC-licensed registered agent level.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry - electronic name reservation lodged exclusively through VFSC-licensed registered agents (VFSC e-Register Portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory company names must be in English or French; the name must be expressed exclusively in Latin script (A-Z letters, Arabic numerals 0-9, and limited punctuation); non-Latin characters (e.g., Mandarin characters, Cyrillic, Arabic script) are not accepted for registration; the name must be capable of unambiguous transliteration into English or French for commercial instruments, bills of lading, and SWIFT payment fields; the name must end with the required legal element indicator 'Limited' or 'Ltd' for an International Company.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any token implying sovereign or state sponsorship
Any token implying an unlicensed regulated activity
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection the applicant, acting through its VFSC-licensed registered agent, may file a written Request for Re-consideration with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice, submitting supporting evidence (e.g., trademark registration, prior use affidavit, or consent letter from an existing name holder) and paying the prescribed reconsideration fee. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the VFSC Board of Appeal within 21 days; a further judicial review may be commenced before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. A pending name reservation may be extended once upon payment of an additional VFSC fee; if the reservation window lapses without extension, a fresh clearance application and additional fee are required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not permissible for the statutory registered office: an International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the professional address of a VFSC-licensed registered agent. A purely remote cross-border trading operation in used heavy machinery (ISIC 4659) does not require local operational premises, but the physical registered agent address remains mandatory and must appear on all corporate records; day-to-day trading activities may be conducted entirely offshore.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified risk: estimated 5% to 10% probability of unannounced regulatory inspection in any given year for a pure cross-border wholesale remarketing entity with no local physical assets; the primary inspection exposure rests on the licensed registered agent's client files and UBO records. Suspicious activity reporting triggers or adverse media alerts would raise that probability materially.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC statutory company name clearance and reservation fee (single application window)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the VFSC Companies Registry fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT client onboarding and UBO KYC package (identity verification, PEP determination, OFAC/UN/EU/domestic sanctions screening, risk rating file)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent / retained legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a medium-risk trading entity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership register setup and first-year restricted-access register maintenance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark pricing in Port Vila for International Company administration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille certification of UBO/director certified copies (bundle of 3-5 documents in country of origin)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent authority in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff and Hague Convention authentication fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English or French translation of supporting corporate documents (if the originating language is a non-official script)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per-page rate for commercial certified translation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Physical registered office in Vanuatu (first-year provision)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark annual registered office fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent services for the first year (pre-incorporation advisory through filing support and VFSC interface)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark annual registered agent fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of International Company constitutional documents (Memorandum and Articles of Association) and corporate records
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark professional fee for standard International Company incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency legal advisory reserve for name rejection appeal and regulatory correspondence
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark hourly / ad hoc retainer basis

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 220], as amended, sections 3 to 7 (registration), 15 and 16 (memorandum and articles), 19 to 23 (directors, secretary and registered office); Companies (Fees and Forms) Regulations as updated by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry Services Division
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association and Application for Registration of an International Company (Form IC-01)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Shares may be issued at par, at a premium, or for such consideration as the subscribers agree; no escrow or fund deposit account is required for an International Company under Vanuatu law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the subscription of shares by the initial shareholder and the allotment of one ordinary share per subscriber in accordance with the Register of Members be and is hereby ratified; (2) the address notified by the Registered Agent is adopted as the registered office of the Company for service of process and all statutory purposes; (3) [Name] be and is hereby appointed as Director and [Name] as Company Secretary, each to serve until the next annual general meeting or until vacated by operation of law; and (4) all actions taken by the Registered Agent to file the Memorandum and Articles with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission be and are hereby confirmed and ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and Name Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC via a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select a VFSC-licensed registered agent and submit a proposed company name for preliminary screening. The agent lodges an automated or written name-search request with the Registry Services Division; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and must not suggest a prohibited activity.
required_dossiers: Signed engagement letter with the registered agent
Proposed company name in Latin script with corporate suffix 'Limited' or 'Company'
Declared intended business description for the name-search request
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file an alternative name within 48 hours through the same registered agent; no new statutory fee is payable unless the alternative name requires special screening.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Target-drafting section of the registered agent with VFSC submission in mind
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English. The documents must specify the liability of members is limited, the share structure, and confirm that the company is incorporated as an International Company. Each initial director and the company secretary must execute consent forms.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft and executed)
Consent to act as Director for each initial director
Consent to act as Secretary by the secretary or secretarial body
Register of Members and Register of Directors
Certified passport copy of each director, beneficial owner, and shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC queries or rejects the constitutional documents for insufficient execution or conflicting provisions, execute a corrected revision and resubmit through the registered agent; a brief statutory declaration of corrections may be required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation and Registered Office Particulars to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Registry Services Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Filed by the registered agent: submit the executed incorporation package, Form IC-01, particulars of registered office in Vanuatu, and proof of the prescribed government filing fee. The Commission verifies the statutory contents and, when satisfied, issues the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form IC-01)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certified copy of the registered agent consent letter naming the registered office in Vanuatu
Certificate of payment of registration fee
Identity and address verification documents for initial directors and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for missing or irregular particulars, the registered agent files an amendment sheet or corrective statutory declaration within five working days; no repeat submission is required if the original application is merely marked for supplementary information.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After approval, the VFSC seals the certificate, files the constitutional documents, and issues a Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent obtains certified copies, an extract of the register, and if requested, a certificate of good standing.
required_dossiers: Original Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent's receipt of the definitive corporate dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Corrections to the certificate, such as typographical errors in the corporate name or date, are remedied by a formal notice to the VFSC; a supplementary certificate is issued without a second full review normally.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Formal Board and Shareholder Organisation Post-Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors and registered agent acting for the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, approve the pro-forma first board resolution, adopt the registered office, appoint officers, open corporate records, issue share certificates, and if needed, open a correspondent bank account or agent account. Minutes and resolutions are kept in the registered agent's file.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting or unanimous written resolution
Board-adopted registered office address confirmation
Share certificates and share transfer instruments, if applicable
Oath or compliance declaration to VFSC where the company elects to obtain a certificate of good standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any non-conforming record, such as an omitted share certificate stamp or incomplete director consent, is cured by executing a rectification resolution and filing a copy in the corporate records; third-party reliance documents are reissued at the agent's cost if the error is administrative.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board applies; the entity operates solely as a wholesale remarketing trader of used construction machinery under ISIC 4659 and NAICS 423810.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no manufacturing, processing, or industrial operation permit required under Vanuatu law for pure trading and re-export of used construction equipment.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Category 4 – no full Environmental Impact Assessment report required for wholesale remarketing, storage in closed warehouses, and movement of used machinery; an EIA would only be triggered by on-island dismantling, repair, washing, or any operation releasing petroleum residues or hazardous waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero discharge to soil or groundwater and zero uncontrolled VOC emissions; any incidental spill during storage or handling must be contained and reported under the Waste Management Act; used machinery retained on island must be drained of fluids and secured before warehousing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services covering the registered office and any warehouse; occupational workplace clearance confirming evacuation routes, adequate ventilation, fire extinguisher placement, and structural load capacity for stored machinery; no civil defense clearance is required for an offshore trading company without a physical factory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu. Corporate registry and International Company (IC) administration: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), https://vfsc.vu. Customs declarations processed through the ASYCUDA World electronic single window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Appoint a VFSC-licensed registered agent to incorporate an International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; the agent files the Memorandum and Articles of Association with the VFSC Registry. Step 2: Obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and compliance certificate (typically within 24 hours). Step 3: A tax-exempt IC trading exclusively offshore receives automatic exemption under IC Act s.3 and is not required to obtain a VAT TIN or file tax returns. Step 4: If acting as importer/exporter of record in Vanuatu, obtain a customs code via the ASYCUDA World registration process. Step 5: Exceptionally, if taxable supplies were to be made in Vanuatu without VFSC approval (a regulatory breach), an 8-digit TIN and VAT registration would be applied for through the VCIR Taxpayer Registration Application within 21 days of exceeding the VT 10,000,000 annual turnover threshold. Step 6: File the annual VFSC return through the registered agent (administrative compliance only, not a tax filing).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (statutory zero-tax regime for International Companies; territorial restriction applies - no business with Vanuatu residents, no local real estate except approved administrative premises; foreign-source trading income, capital gains, and distributions remain outside the Vanuatu tax net entirely).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regime exists in Vanuatu because no general income tax law is in force. The operative elections are: (a) incorporation election - shareholders elect the International Companies Act [Cap 222] regime to obtain the irrevocable statutory tax exemption; (b) voluntary VAT registration under s.29(2) VAT Act for persons below the mandatory threshold, useful for recovering input VAT on zero-rated export activities; (c) election to zero-rate certain services supplied to non-residents under the VAT Act First Schedule; and (d) customs transit/bond election under the Customs Act No. 14 of 2013 for re-export of used construction machinery through Vanuatu ports without VAT or duty. Vanuatu has no double tax treaties; treaty-shopping and hybrid mismatch concepts are therefore not applicable, but substance documentation remains prudent for correspondent banking and SWIFT LC facilitation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 273], administered nationally by the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue; supplemented by the Customs Act No. 14 of 2013 for import/export control.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 (10 million vatu) annual taxable turnover; registration is mandatory within 21 days of exceeding the threshold; non-resident suppliers without a Vanuatu fixed establishment are generally outside the VAT net except for supplies physically enjoyed in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API e-invoicing mandate applies. VAT-registered suppliers issue paper or PDF tax invoices containing the prescribed content under s.12 VAT Act (supplier identity, TIN, serial number, date, description, tax-exclusive consideration, VAT amount and rate). VAT returns (Form VAT 100) are filed electronically through the VCIR portal; customs export entries are lodged electronically in ASYCUDA World. Records must be retained for a minimum of 7 years under s.70 VAT Act.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating at 0% applies to goods physically removed from Vanuatu within 28 days of supply (or such longer period as the Commissioner allows) under the VAT Act First Schedule. Offshore services (trading facilitation, logistics, brokerage, inspection coordination for used hydraulic earthmovers and rollers) supplied to a non-resident outside Vanuatu at the time of supply, and not enjoyed in Vanuatu, are equally zero-rated. Eligibility requires an active VAT registration (mandatory or voluntary), a valid tax invoice, and documentary proof of export. Input VAT incurred on local costs supporting the export (storage, handling, freight, surveying) is creditable under s.17 and refundable under s.33 VAT Act. An unregistered IC trading goods directly from foreign suppliers to foreign buyers is outside the Vanuatu VAT system altogether, and re-export of used machinery through Vanuatu in customs transit/bond is not a taxable supply.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration in ASYCUDA World with customs officer exit endorsement
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill) evidencing foreign port of discharge and overseas consignee
Inward Remittance Advice/Certificate from the receiving bank evidencing settlement of export proceeds (banking documentary practice; no statutory exchange control exists in Vanuatu)
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the export declaration
VAT-compliant export tax invoice and, where applicable, container/haulage tracking reports evidencing physical removal
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu law imposes no statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline and maintains no exchange controls; the 180-day parameter reflects standard export settlement practice and bank documentary policy rather than a statutory cap. Fraudulent export zero-rating or refund claims constitute an offence under s.82 VAT Act, punishable by imprisonment of up to 2 years and/or monetary fines at the court's discretion, together with recovery of the evaded tax, a penalty of up to 25% of the unpaid amount, and 2% per month default interest under s.75 VAT Act. Incorrect customs declarations attract penalties under the Customs Act No. 14 of 2013 of up to three times the value of the goods. The Commissioner may retrospectively claw back refunds, amend assessments, cancel registration, and refer the matter to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit under the AML/CFT framework; an IC breaching the no-resident-business covenant additionally risks VFSC deregistration and forfeiture of the s.3 statutory exemption.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 74] and the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act; routine administration is delegated to authorized dealers. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) maintains the IC register, UBO declarations, and AML/CFT supervision of registered agents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The VUV floats in a thin onshore FX market. Resident capital-account outflows require RBV consent; non-resident International Companies (ICs) that transact exclusively in foreign currencies and do not deal with Vanuatu residents are treated as external persons and exempt from capital-control restrictions under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. Dividend/profit remittances in USD require no RBV clearance, subject only to bank due diligence; any VUV-denominated transaction or resident payment would undermine the exemption.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory baseline for resident exporters: proceeds must be received within 6 months of export shipment and surrendered to an authorized dealer within 3 months of receipt, at a mandatory conversion ratio of 100% of net proceeds after directly attributed offshore expenses; deferred surrender requires specific RBV permission. The IC qualifies for automatic exemption as a non-resident foreign-currency trader, provided all used-machinery sale proceeds are settled outside Vanuatu in USD/AUD/EUR and no surrender obligation is triggered.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-Low. Vanuatu lacks a dedicated e-money licensing regime; offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Airwallex, Currencycloud) are not RBV-authorized dealers and may support only ancillary USD collection and FX execution, never sole settlement. Third-country EMI balances must survive the correspondent 'chain of custody' review of the Vanuatu bank; any crypto-linked or unlicensed wallet facilitator is categorically incompatible with VFSC AML expectations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted only via a licensed registered agent that physically verifies directors and UBOs and couriers apostilled certified documents to the bank. For a medium-risk trading IC, at least one executive director or authorized signatory must attend an in-person director verification interview at the Port Vila branch before capital escrow activation; enhanced due diligence escalates to a video-KYC call and notarized source-of-funds declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trust or nominee opacity in the IC beneficial ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC UBO register extract; redacted trust deed schedule of settlor/beneficiaries; registered agent certification; sworn UBO affidavit; apostilled passport copies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Round-tripping red flags in used-machinery remittances via high-risk transit jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized sale/purchase agreements; ICC-compatible invoices; SGS/Bureau Veritas inspection certificates; bills of lading and terminal receipts; prior dealer trade references.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: End-user sanctions exposure in mining/earthmoving markets
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Refinitiv/Dow Jones screening reports; end-use and end-user certificates; US/EU re-export authorization memos; corporate OFAC sanctions compliance policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No physical premises in Vanuatu under registered-agent structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certificate of incorporation and good standing; registered agent agreement; office-lite or service-provider substance contract; signed directors' mandate; corporate register extracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intercompany/third-party payment flows lacking economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited/management financial statements; board resolution authorizing each payment; payment-invoice reconciliation matrix; letter of assurance against third-party funds; ISIC 4659-aligned transfer pricing documentation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 in USD from the shareholder's own bank to the IC's USD account at ANZ/BSP; beneficiary narrative: 'Direct investment - International Company under IC Act Cap. 222'; supporting file: VFSC good standing, board capital-subscription resolution, register of members, registered-agent compliance letter. Funds must originate from an AD-approved correspondent jurisdiction; no RBV prior approval is needed for an exempt non-resident IC equity injection; retain the inward credit advice for statutory audit purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Standard settlements use SWIFT MT103 USD telegraphic transfers; high-value used-excavator purchases use irrevocable documentary credits (UCP600) and Commercial LCs payable against inspection certificate, bill of lading, insurance certificate, and commercial invoice; standby LCs serve as performance instruments. VUV-denominated payments and Vanuatu-resident payees are prohibited; all legs settle through the IC's USD account with same-day FX confirmation, and correspondent routing should use Australia, Singapore, or USA to reduce relay-chain risk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore outright USD/VUV spot contracts with an authorized dealer (limited Port Vila book)
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/VUV through licensed international bank counterparties
Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV) with an RBV-licensed bank, permissible for non-resident IC exposure
Natural hedging via exclusive USD invoicing and USD-valued machinery inventory without VUV conversion
Plain-vanilla OTC FX options on USD/VUV used solely for trade-hedging and subject to bank credit approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Confirmation Statement) for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six calendar months after the anniversary date of incorporation; payable annually on the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of VUV 10,000 (approximately USD 85) per month or part thereof; continued default for 3 months may trigger notice of administrative strike-off; failure to remedy leads to dissolution of the company

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a Vanuatu International Company unless its members resolve to have one or the VFSC directs an examination under the International Companies Act; audit exemption applies regardless of turnover or assets
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Company must keep accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and financial position; IFRS or local GAAP may be used if financial statements are voluntarily prepared

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO filing is required in Vanuatu, but the International Company must maintain a register of beneficial owners at the registered office; any transfer of shares must be entered in the register of members and the register of beneficial owners updated within 14 days of notification

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (no statutory audit required; voluntary audit typical fee USD 3,000 - 6,000)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu levies no national corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, and no net-worth tax; the International Company is not subject to any income-based levy on its foreign-source wholesale trading income)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No tax holiday is needed because the general corporate tax rate itself is nil. The International Company enjoys a de facto 0% effective rate on offshore sales of used construction excavators and rollers. Indirect taxes are confined to domestic activity: Service Tax (now transitioning to a successor VAT regime) at 12.5% applies only to taxable supplies made within Vanuatu, customs import duty applies only to goods entering Vanuatu territory, and municipal business licence fees apply only to a physical place of business inside a municipal boundary. A properly ring-fenced IC trading ex-Vanuatu escapes all of these.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Form AR-IC (International Company Annual Return) filed electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry portal 'My VFSC'.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within one calendar month after each anniversary of the date of incorporation shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the International Company and its VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name exactly as it appears on the Certificate of Incorporation; any trading name or English translation must not be substituted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu (physical street address, not a P.O. Box), maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the registered office is in Port Vila or Luganville and is operated by the IC's appointed registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and VFSC licence number of the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The overseas shareholder may not act as the registered agent; a VFSC-licensed agent is mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, classes of shares, and number of shares in issue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are prohibited; full beneficial ownership data must be disclosed to the registered agent for the VFSC beneficial-ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full particulars of directors, company secretary, and shareholders (names, addresses, nationalities).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All directors may be non-resident; nonetheless, append the executed power of attorney under which the registered agent accepts service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration that the IC has not carried on, and will not carry on, business in Vanuatu or with Vanuatu residents, unless an international company licence has been issued by the Minister of Finance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A trading IC dealing in used excavators offshore must declare no onshore Vanuatu activity; owning Vanuatu real property without a licence is a separate strict-law violation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director or of the registered agent on behalf of the board.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Electronic signature by a non-resident director is accepted via the e-Registry; the agent's countersignature certifies the information against its client file.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No income-tax late-filing surcharge applies because no corporate income tax return exists. However, the VFSC Fees Regulations impose a monthly late penalty for each month or part of a month after the anniversary deadline; continued default results in registry strike-off, reinstatement costs, and the registered agent's contractual right to resign, which itself is a trigger for deregistration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VIRC Service Tax Return (Form ST-100) filed electronically through the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VIRC) eServices portal; required only if the IC registers for domestic Service Tax on local taxable supplies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly, with a quarterly filing option for taxpayers below the small-taxpayer turnover threshold.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Monthly returns are due by the last day of the month immediately following the close of the tax period; the annual reconciliation is due by 30 June following the calendar year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of taxable supplies delivered in Vanuatu (for a heavy-machinery trader: local sale or terminal-lease of an excavator inside Vanuatu).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC that merely arranges export of used excavators from a foreign port to a foreign buyer is not making taxable supplies in Vanuatu and should not complete this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of zero-rated and exempt supplies, including exported secondhand construction machinery shipped directly from outside Vanuatu to the buyer's jurisdiction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Evidence of the bill of lading, the letter of credit, and the non-Vanuatu delivery address must be retained to prove the export character.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Input tax credits, including any customs duty or service tax suffered on spare parts, transport, and agent fees used for local taxable supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses attributable to recognised Vanuatu taxable supplies are creditable; offshore freight of used excavators is not creditable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net Service Tax payable at 12.5% on the positive difference between output and input tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the IC has no Vanuatu supply chain, the correct filing is a 'nil' return, and the IC may instead apply for deregistration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fixed penalty plus a 25% late-payment surcharge on the unpaid tax; under-declaration discovered on audit attracts a shortfall penalty of up to 150% of the omitted tax; deliberate false statements expose directors to criminal prosecution under the Tax Administration and Penal Code.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch remittance tax, and no tax on distributions by an International Company to its non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable because Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; there is therefore no treaty-reduced rate and no administrative relief procedure. Where a foreign bank or commercial counterparty requires a formal document, the IC may obtain from the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs a 'Certificate of Tax Status' (a de facto tax residence certificate) confirming that the IC has no Vanuatu income-tax liability. The non-resident shareholder should nonetheless secure a residence certificate from its own fiscal authority to claim foreign tax credits on the underlying dividends and to demonstrate that central management and control is not located in Vanuatu.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on both cross-border royalties (including payments for re-engineering data and machinery IP) and debt interest. Because no DTA exists, no treaty rate floor applies; the rates remain zero whether the payee is a resident or non-resident. The operative risk is entirely foreign-side: the lender or IP owner's home jurisdiction may characterise the receipt as taxable income, and the IC's directors should document the arm's-length nature of every intercompany payment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VUV 0 — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing statute, no thin-capitalisation rule, and no statutory documentation threshold; the prudent non-resident trader is nonetheless recommended to prepare OECD-aligned Local File and Master File documentation whenever related-party transactions involving the purchase or onward sale of used excavators exceed VUV 50,000,000 (approximately USD 400,000) in any annual period, in order to pre-empt the tax administration of the counterparty jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) and does not require an International Company to prove payroll, premises, or core-income-generating activities within Vanuatu. The IC Act nevertheless prohibits onshore business without a ministerial licence, and the VFSC applies a beneficial-ownership due-diligence standard. OECD, EU listing, and FATF evaluations continue to scrutinise shell-structure risk, so practical substance — a local registered agent, a Vanuatu-registered office, properly executed board minutes, a Vanuatu bank account or a reputable offshore bank account in the IC's own name, and a complete commercial file for each excavator transaction (purchase invoice, bill of lading, inspection report, sale invoice, and SWIFT/LC payment route) — is required to avoid bank de-risking and cross-border re-characterisation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing a false VFSC annual return or a false 'Certificate of Tax Status', declaring that the IC has no Vanuatu business when in fact the excavator trading operations are managed and controlled from Vanuatu, or using the zero-tax IC wrapper deliberately to conceal taxable income from the shareholder's residence jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) and the Penal Code: a fine not exceeding VUV 10,000,000 and a continuing daily default fine, together with an obligation to restore any tax advantage; in the foreign jurisdiction, the reconstructed corporate residence triggers full CIT, penalties up to 100–150% of the tax shortfall, and criminal tax-fraud charges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced: directors and the controlling shareholder face personal civil liability for the full restitution sum, disqualification from serving as directors of any VFSC-regulated entity, asset-freeze orders, travel bans, and, upon extradition, imprisonment for tax offences in the shareholder's home country.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Abusive Use of the IC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a pure mailbox entity: no office, no independent bank account, no board minutes, no transaction file, and no economic activity in either Vanuatu or the counterparty jurisdiction, while routing large-value payments for used construction excavators through the IC solely to access zero-tax status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registry-level action by the VFSC: deregistration and strike-off of the IC, automatic loss of the legal personality that supports the limited-liability shield, and inclusion of the restructured owner on adverse international risk databases maintained by FATF, the OECD Global Forum, and correspondent banks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Deregistration retroactively exposes directors and shareholders to unlimited personal liability for the company's debts, including unpaid seller price of the excavators and unpaid LC reimbursements; directors also face a five-year ban from incorporation duties in Vanuatu and equivalent rejection in other offshore registries.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Trade-Based Money Laundering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving the purchase price of used excavators through third-party payment chains, split-wire structures, cash deposits, or over/under-invoicing of the machinery (e.g., invoicing a USD 600,000 excavator at USD 200,000 on the bill of lading while settling USD 400,000 outside the banking system), without a complete know-your-customer file on the end-buyer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Proceeds of Crime Act (Vanuatu) and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act: money laundering is an indictable offence punishable by imprisonment up to 20 years for individuals and a fine up to VUV 50,000,000 for a body corporate; the underlying transaction is voidable, and the funds are subject to confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the beneficial owner are jointly and severally liable for the confiscated value, face immediate travel bans and freezing orders issued by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, and, on conviction, custodial sentences with extradition risk to the buyer or seller jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Cross-Border Profit Stripping and Misalignment of Tax Residence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Interposing the Vanuatu IC as a booking company between a related supplier and a related end-customer while the actual negotiation, inspection of hydraulic earthmovers and rollers, risk-taking, and credit functions are performed by employees of the parent group in another country; the IC books a 45–60% gross margin with no corresponding operational substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The foreign tax administration reallocates the profit under its controlled-foreign-company, transfer-pricing, or place-of-management rules; the IC is treated as tax-resident where central management and control actually lies, yielding back taxes, 100–200% accuracy-related penalties, and interest; Vanuatu levies no additional tax because the reallocated income is never subject to Vanuatu CIT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign the intercompany sale and purchase agreements without arm's-length benchmarking are personally liable for the resulting tax shortfall as 'responsible persons'; anti-avoidance legislation in major trading-partner states permits criminal indictment of the directing mind and travel-banned cross-border enforcement against personal assets.
